package.name: mppi_repro_harness
package.description: Standalone reproduction harness for the costs_ heap-corruption bug (doldrive_ws investigation, 2026-08-09). Drives mppi::Optimizer directly with a control-loop thread and an in-process parameter-spam thread, bypassing controller_server/bt_navigator/planner_server/DDS entirely so ASan's dlopen-time shadow-memory setup has far less address-space complexity to contend with. Debug-only, not for deployment.
